verses.en: Then Job answered and said,
verses.pt: Então Jó respondeu:
verses.en_web: Then Job answered,
verses.en_bbe: And Job made answer and said,

verses.en: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
verses.pt: Até quando afligireis a minha alma, e me atormentareis com palavras?
verses.en_web: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
verses.en_bbe: How long will you make my life bitter, crushing me with words?

verses.en: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
verses.pt: Já dez vezes me haveis humilhado; não vos envergonhais de me maltratardes?
verses.en_web: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
verses.en_bbe: Ten times now you have made sport of me; it gives you no sense of shame to do me wrong.

verses.en: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.pt: Embora haja eu, na verdade, errado, comigo fica o meu erro.
verses.en_web: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
verses.en_bbe: And, truly, if I have been in error, the effect of my error is only on myself.

verses.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
verses.pt: Se deveras vos quereis engrandecer contra mim, e me incriminar pelo meu opróbrio,
verses.en_web: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach;
verses.en_bbe: If you make yourselves great against me, using my punishment as an argument against me,

verses.en: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
verses.pt: sabei então que Deus é o que transtornou a minha causa, e com a sua rede me cercou.
verses.en_web: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
verses.en_bbe: Be certain that it is God who has done me wrong, and has taken me in his net.

verses.en: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
verses.pt: Eis que clamo: Violência! mas não sou ouvido; grito: Socorro! mas não há justiça.
verses.en_web: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I make an outcry against the violent man, but there is no answer: I give a cry for help, but no one takes up my cause.

verses.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.pt: com muros fechou ele o meu caminho, de modo que não posso passar; e pôs trevas nas minhas veredas.
verses.en_web: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
verses.en_bbe: My way is walled up by him so that I may not go by: he has made my roads dark.

verses.en: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
verses.pt: Da minha honra me despojou, e tirou-me da cabeça a coroa.
verses.en_web: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
verses.en_bbe: He has put off my glory from me, and taken the crown from my head.

verses.en: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
verses.pt: Quebrou-me de todos os lados, e eu me vou; arrancou a minha esperança, como a, uma árvore.
verses.en_web: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. My hope he has plucked up like a tree.
verses.en_bbe: I am broken down by him on every side, and I am gone; my hope is uprooted like a tree.

verses.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
verses.pt: Acende contra mim a sua ira, e me considera como um de seus adversários.
verses.en_web: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: His wrath is burning against me, and I am to him as one of his haters.

verses.en: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
verses.pt: Juntas as suas tropas avançam, levantam contra mim o seu caminho, e se acampam ao redor da minha tenda.
verses.en_web: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
verses.en_bbe: His armies come on together, they make their road high against me, and put up their tents round mine.

verses.en: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
verses.pt: Ele pôs longe de mim os meus irmãos, e os que me conhecem tornaram-se estranhos para mim.
verses.en_web: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
verses.en_bbe: He has taken my brothers far away from me; they have seen my fate and have become strange to me.

verses.en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.pt: Os meus parentes se afastam, e os meus conhecidos se esquecem de, mim.
verses.en_web: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.en_bbe: My relations and my near friends have given me up, and those living in my house have put me out of their minds.

verses.en: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.pt: Os meus domésticos e as minhas servas me têm por estranho; vim a ser um estrangeiro aos seus olhos.
verses.en_web: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
verses.en_bbe: I am strange to my women-servants, and seem to them as one from another country.

verses.en: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
verses.pt: Chamo ao meu criado, e ele não me responde; tenho que suplicar-lhe com a minha boca.
verses.en_web: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: At my cry my servant gives me no answer, and I have to make a prayer to him.

verses.en: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.
verses.pt: O meu hÁlito é intolerável à minha mulher; sou repugnante aos filhos de minhã mae.
verses.en_web: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
verses.en_bbe: My breath is strange to my wife, and I am disgusting to the offspring of my mother's body.

verses.en: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
verses.pt: Até os pequeninos me desprezam; quando me levanto, falam contra mim.
verses.en_web: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
verses.en_bbe: Even young children have no respect for me; when I get up their backs are turned on me.

verses.en: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.pt: Todos os meus amigos íntimos me abominam, e até os que eu amava se tornaram contra mim.
verses.en_web: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
verses.en_bbe: All the men of my circle keep away from me; and those dear to me are turned against me.

verses.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.pt: Os meus ossos se apegam à minha pele e à minha carne, e só escapei com a pele dos meus dentes.
verses.en_web: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
verses.en_bbe: My bones are joined to my skin, and I have got away with my flesh in my teeth.

verses.en: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
verses.pt: Compadecei-vos de mim, amigos meus; compadecei-vos de mim; pois a mão de Deus me tocou.
verses.en_web: “Have pity on me, have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
verses.en_bbe: Have pity on me, have pity on me, O my friends! for the hand of God is on me.

verses.en: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.pt: Por que me perseguis assim como Deus, e da minha carne não vos fartais?
verses.en_web: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.en_bbe: Why are you cruel to me, like God, for ever saying evil against me?

verses.en: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
verses.pt: Oxalá que as minhas palavras fossem escritas! Oxalá que fossem gravadas num livro!
verses.en_web: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
verses.en_bbe: If only my words might be recorded! if they might be put in writing in a book!

verses.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
verses.pt: Que, com pena de ferro, e com chumbo, fossem para sempre esculpidas na rocha!
verses.en_web: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
verses.en_bbe: And with an iron pen and lead be cut into the rock for ever!

verses.en: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
verses.pt: Pois eu sei que o meu Redentor vive, e que por fim se levantará sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
verses.en_bbe: But I am certain that he who will take up my cause is living, and that in time to come he will take his place on the dust;

verses.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
verses.pt: E depois de consumida esta minha pele, então fora da minha carne verei a Deus;
verses.en_web: After my skin is destroyed, then in my flesh shall I see God,
verses.en_bbe: And ... without my flesh I will see God;

verses.en: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
verses.pt: vê-lo-ei ao meu lado, e os meus olhos o contemplarão, e não mais como adversário. O meu coração desfalece dentro de mim!
verses.en_web: Whom I, even I, shall see on my side. My eyes shall see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
verses.en_bbe: Whom I will see on my side, and not as one strange to me. My heart is broken with desire.

verses.en: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
verses.pt: Se disserdes: Como o havemos de perseguir! e que a causa deste mal se acha em mim,
verses.en_web: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
verses.en_bbe: If you say, How cruel we will be to him! because the root of sin is clearly in him:

verses.en: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
verses.pt: temei vós a espada; porque o furor traz os castigos da espada, para saberdes que há um juízo.
verses.en_web: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
verses.en_bbe: Be in fear of the sword, for the sword is the punishment for such things, so that you may be certain that there is a judge.
